_note: FIGO staging of cancer of the cervix uteri (2018), as used by the National Cancer Grid of India (NCG gynaecological cancer guidelines 2019). Transcribed word for word from Table 1 of Bhatla N, Aoki D, Sharma DN, Sankaranarayanan R. Cancer of the cervix uteri: 2021 update. Int J Gynecol Obstet 2021;155(Suppl 1):28-44 (open access, CC BY-NC-ND; full text read from Europe PMC, PMC9298213). The book page (pages and highlights) is filled in once the PDF is on the server (book.file). FIGO allots one stage: local extent (the 'T' list), then lymph nodes (Stage IIIC, with r or p), then distant organs (IVB); 'When in doubt, the lower staging should be assigned' (note d). N0 and M0 are not FIGO lines: they say that IIIC or IVB does not apply. Not switched on until a clinician has checked this file (docs/staging/DECISION.md, guard 5).
label: Cervical cancer, FIGO 2018

book.title: FIGO: Cancer of the cervix uteri, 2021 update (Bhatla et al., IJGO 2021), Table 1

T.ask: the size of the cervical tumour (greatest dimension); the depth of stromal invasion on pathology; involvement of the vagina (upper two-thirds or lower third); parametrial involvement; extension to the pelvic wall; hydronephrosis or a nonfunctioning kidney; biopsy-proven involvement of the bladder or rectal mucosa, or spread beyond the true pelvis

N.ask: pelvic lymph nodes and para-aortic lymph nodes: whether a report states metastasis, on imaging (r) or on pathology (p)

M.ask: spread to distant organs (lung, liver, bone, distant lymph nodes)

T.text: Measured stromal invasion ≤3 mm in depth
T.find: Measured stromal invasion ≤3 mm in depth

T.text: Measured stromal invasion >3 and ≤5 mm in depth
T.find: Measured stromal invasion >3 and ≤5 mm in depth

T.text: Invasive carcinoma >5 mm depth of stromal invasion and ≤2 cm in greatest dimension
Invasive carcinoma >2 and ≤4 cm in greatest dimension
Invasive carcinoma >4 cm in greatest dimension
T.find: Invasive carcinoma >4 cm in greatest dimension

T.text: Involvement limited to the upper two-thirds of the vagina without parametrial involvement (IIA1: invasive carcinoma ≤4 cm in greatest dimension; IIA2: invasive carcinoma >4 cm in greatest dimension)
T.find: Involvement limited to the upper two

T.text: With parametrial involvement but not up to the pelvic wall
T.find: With parametrial involvement but not up to the pelvic wall

T.text: The carcinoma involves the lower third of the vagina, with no extension to the pelvic wall
T.find: involves the lower third of the vagina, with no extension

T.text: Extension to the pelvic wall and/or hydronephrosis or nonfunctioning kidney (unless known to be due to another cause)
Spread of the growth to adjacent pelvic organs (the mucosa of the bladder or rectum, biopsy proven); a bullous edema, as such, does not permit a case to be allotted to Stage IV
T.find: Spread of the growth to adjacent pelvic organs

N.text: No pelvic or para-aortic lymph node metastasis stated (Stage IIIC does not apply)

M.text: No spread to distant organs stated (Stage IVB does not apply)

groups.title: FIGO staging of cancer of the cervix uteri (2018)
groups.find: FIGO staging of cancer of the cervix uteri (2018)
groups.note: FIGO allots one stage: distant organs (IVB) first, then adjacent pelvic organs (IVA), then lymph nodes (IIIC, irrespective of tumour size and extent, with r for imaging and p for pathology), else the local extent. When in doubt, the lower staging should be assigned (FIGO 2018, note d).
